<observations>
Date: Mar 2, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User is building Ledgerly, a TypeScript invoicing SaaS targeting freelancers in Canada.
* 🔴 (09:05) User prefers using VSCode extensions for linting.
* 🔴 (09:14) User's teammate Priyanka Vashisht reviews all database migrations.
* 🟡 (11:45) Agent successfully set up the project, installed dependencies, and compiled the TypeScript codebase.
* 🔴 (12:30) User asked about PDF generation; PDFKit (v0.13.0) was chosen and implemented with a placeholder function and passing unit tests.
* 🟢 (17:55) User will review the test coverage report later.
* 🟡 (19:10) Agent scheduled a reminder for the user to push changes to the feature/pdf-generation branch by 22:00.
* 🔴 (21:30) User decided to name the primary database schema `ledgerly_core`.

Date: Mar 5, 2026
* 🔴 (07:45) User decided to protect the API with JWT authentication.
* ✅ (10:00) Agent implemented JWT token generation with `jsonwebtoken@9.0.0` and passing unit tests.
* 🔴 (10:45) User asked about setting up continuous integration with GitHub Actions.
* ✅ (12:15) Agent configured and verified a GitHub Actions CI workflow for Node 18, npm install, build, and test steps.
* 🔴 (13:00) User wants automatic version bumping using `standard-version`.
* ✅ (14:30) Agent added an npm "release" script using `standard-version` and generated a changelog entry.
* 🔴 (15:15) User asked about using Stripe for payment processing.
* 🟡 (17:30) Agent noted `stripe-node v4.5.0` is present and created a placeholder `chargeCustomer` function.
* 🟡 (19:00) Agent scheduled a reminder for the user to review Stripe webhook handling by Friday.

Date: Mar 8, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User decided to implement audit logging for all invoice modifications.
* 🟡 (07:45) Agent created a basic `logInfo` function using `winston v3.8.2`.
* 🔴 (09:00) User asked how to integrate the logger into the invoice rendering workflow.
* ✅ (09:35) Agent integrated the logger into `src/invoice/render.ts` and confirmed all tests passed.
* 🔴 (11:05) User aims for at least 85% code coverage.
* ✅ (12:30) Agent configured Jest for coverage, achieved 87% coverage, and committed improvements to the audit/logging branch.
* 🔴 (13:45) User decided to send logs to Loggly via HTTP endpoint.
* ✅ (15:00) Agent configured Loggly transport and verified integration with passing mocked tests.
* 🟡 (16:30) Agent scheduled a reminder for the user to review logging documentation by tomorrow morning.
* 🟢 (17:55) User will review and provide feedback after the team standup.

Date: Mar 11, 2026
* 🟡 (08:30) Agent merged the `feature/pdf-generation` branch into `main` and opened a PR.
* 🟢 (09:05) CI pipeline passed on the merged commit.
* 🔴 (09:45) User asked whether generated PDFs should include QR codes for payment links.
* ✅ (10:55) Agent implemented QR code generation using `qrcode v1.5.2` in `src/invoice/render.ts` and updated tests.
* 🟢 (11:30) User confirmed QR code appears correctly in local PDF tests.
* 🔴 (12:45) User decided to expose a new endpoint `GET /invoices/:id/pdf` for downloading invoices.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent created and integrated an Express handler for the PDF download endpoint, with passing integration tests.
* 🔴 (14:20) User stated the production Postgres instance runs in the Frankfurt region.
* 🟢 (14:40) User wants to monitor endpoint latency with Prometheus.
* ✅ (16:00) Agent added Prometheus middleware and instrumented the PDF endpoint, then updated the README with usage examples.
* 🟢 (16:45) Agent scheduled a reminder for the user to deploy changes to staging by 18:00.

Date: Mar 15, 2026
* 🔴 (07:20) User decided to add email notifications for invoice delivery confirmations.
* 🔴 (09:10) User asked whether the email template should be HTML or plain text.
* ✅ (09:45) Agent implemented an HTML email template using Handlebars (`templates/invoiceEmail.hbs`) and `nodemailer@6.9.3`.
* ✅ (10:20) Agent wrote and passed Jest tests for `sendInvoiceEmail` by mocking SMTP transport.
* 🟢 (11:05) User reported a 200ms latency spike on the PDF endpoint in staging.
* 🟡 (11:50) Agent added a custom Prometheus histogram metric for PDF generation duration.
* ✅ (12:35) Agent updated CI to lint Handlebars templates with `hbs-lint`, which passed.
* 🟡 (13:15) Agent merged the email notification branch into `main` and created a PR.
* 🔴 (14:00) User requested to containerize the application with Docker for easier staging deployments.
* ✅ (16:40) Agent created a multi-stage Dockerfile (node:18-alpine), built the image, and pushed it to GitHub Container Registry as `v1.3.0-staging`.
* 🟢 (18:05) User confirmed staging is running the new container and plans end-to-end tests tomorrow.

Date: Mar 19, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User will begin end-to-end testing of the invoice flow tomorrow.
* ✅ (09:30) Agent installed `Cypress@13.2.0`, scaffolded `cypress/integration/invoice_spec.ts` with three scenarios, and passed an initial smoke test.
* 🔴 (10:15) User asked whether Sentry should be used for error tracking in production.
* ✅ (11:45) Agent added `@sentry/node@7.14.0` and created an initialization stub with a unit test verifying DSN from env variable.
* 🔴 (12:30) User requested a health-check endpoint returning JSON status.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent created `GET /health` endpoint with uptime and version fields, and added a passing integration test.
* 🔴 (14:45) User mentioned needing rate limiting on the PDF download endpoint.
* 🟡 (15:30) Agent installed `express-rate-limit@6.7.0` and applied middleware to `src/routes/invoicePdf.ts`.
* 🔴 (16:05) User prefers `pnpm` over `npm` for all install commands.
* ✅ (16:15) Agent updated README with instructions for configuring `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS` and `MAX_REQUESTS`.
* 🟢 (17:00) Agent scheduled a reminder for the user to review Cypress test results after the nightly run.
</observations>
<current-task>
Primary: Implement rate limiting on the PDF download endpoint.
Secondary: User will begin end-to-end testing of the invoice flow tomorrow.
Secondary: User needs to review Cypress test results after the nightly run.
</current-task>
<suggested-response>
The user has stated a preference for `pnpm` over `npm`. I should acknowledge this and confirm I will use `pnpm` for future install commands. I should also confirm the rate limiting implementation and ask if they have any specific configurations in mind for the `express-rate-limit` middleware.
</suggested-response>
